# Research Brief: ARM LIMITED (Company No. 02557590)

Source: Companies House public register, company overview page (https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/02557590), retrieved 2026-11-10.

## What the company is
ARM LIMITED is a UK private limited company registered in England and Wales. It was originally incorporated as WIDELOGIC LIMITED. It was renamed ADVANCED RISC MACHINES LIMITED shortly afterwards and has traded as ARM LIMITED since May 1998. The name history matches the well-known Cambridge-based RISC processor design business. However, the register entry itself does not describe the company's commercial activities.

## Key facts
- **Company number:** 02557590
- **Company type:** Private limited company
- **Status:** Active
- **Incorporated:** 12 November 1990
- **Registered office:** 110 Fulbourn Road, Cambridge, Cambridgeshire, CB1 9NJ
- **Nature of business (SIC):** 82990, Other business support service activities not elsewhere classified

## Previous names
| Name | Period |
| --- | --- |
| WIDELOGIC LIMITED | 12 Nov 1990 to 03 Dec 1990 |
| ADVANCED RISC MACHINES LIMITED | 03 Dec 1990 to 21 May 1998 |

## Filing compliance
- **Last accounts:** made up to 31 March 2026
- **Next accounts:** made up to 31 March 2027, due by 31 December 2027
- **Last confirmation statement:** dated 14 November 2025
- **Next confirmation statement:** statement date 14 November 2026, due by 28 November 2026

The filings appear up to date as of the retrieval date. The next confirmation statement falls due later this month.

## Notes
- The registered SIC code (82990, generic business support) is broad. It does not on its face reflect semiconductor or IP design activity. Further due diligence, such as a review of the filed accounts, would clarify the company's actual activities and its place in any group structure.
- This brief covers company-level information only. Details of individual officers and persons with significant control were not needed for this brief and were not collected.
